facts.fact: 博物馆后部有一间小射击廊，靶子用鲜红颜料画在封窗的木板上，地板是落灰的旧木。
facts.anchor: There’s a shooting gallery in the back of the Museum

facts.fact: 她仍在想 Tobias 的话：若她对枪有把握，恐惧模拟会好面对得多；她不想再模拟，可父亲的眼白等画面总浮上来。
facts.anchor: that if I’d felt confident with the gun, my fear simulation would have been easier to face

facts.fact: 她在射击廊把针射上靶再拔出来回收练靶，针射过之后虽失效力仍可复用。
facts.anchor: Firing needles at the wall targets, then yanking them out of the wood to reload them

facts.fact: Christina 伪装时总被人记住、被注意，Foxes 没赶她走，改让她做潜行训练。
facts.anchor: Instead they’ve switched her over to covert training

facts.fact: 她们带食物和水去 Hub，替通过 Healers 公会入门考试的 Colin 庆祝。
facts.anchor: to celebrate Colin passing the entrance test for the Healers Guild

facts.fact: Rory 从 Candor 医院行政主管办公室偷来一瓶棕色烈酒。
facts.anchor: I stole from the office of a Candor hospital administrator

facts.fact: 屋顶上她想明白：自己没交出去任何一部分，是亲手凿出一块地方，而不是等谁放她进去。
facts.anchor: I’ve carved out a place for myself instead of waiting for someone else to let me into one

facts.fact: 章末 Christina 握住她的手，说她不为自己的遭遇高兴，但为两人相遇高兴，她回一句 Me too。
